chunks.arabic_text: وَبِهَذَا الْإِسْنَادِ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ الصَّالِحِ بْنِ هَيْثَمَ [مِيثَمٍ] عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ع قَالَ

translations.en: And by this chain of narration, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from as-Salih ibn Haytham [Maitham], from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

chunks.arabic_text: ثَلَاثٌ مَنْ كُنَّ فِيهِ اسْتَكْمَلَ خِصَالَ الْإِيمَانِ- مَنْ صَبَرَ عَلَى الظُّلْمِ فَكَظَمَ غَيْظَهُ وَ احْتَسَبَ وَ عَفَا كَانَ مِمَّنْ يُدْخِلُهُ اللَّهُ الْجَنَّةَ وَ يُشَفَّعُ فِي مِثْلِ رَبِيعَةَ وَ مُضَرَ

translations.en: Three qualities: whoever possesses them has completed the characteristics of faith. Whoever is patient with oppression, suppresses his anger, considers it a means of reward, and pardons, will be among those whom Allah will admit to Paradise and grant intercession for, equal to the number of the tribes of Rabi'ah and Mudar.

en.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) outlines three key virtues that complete the qualities of faith: patience in the face of oppression, suppressing anger, and pardoning others while seeking divine reward. A person who embodies these traits is promised entry into Paradise and the honor of interceding for a vast number of people, comparable to the size of major Arab tribes.
en.seo_question: What are the three virtues that complete the characteristics of faith according to Shia hadith?
